displayName: Thorlabs BB1-E03 Broadband Dielectric Mirror (750-1100 nm)

faces._role: front reflective surface — E03 broadband dielectric coating, R > 99% over 750-1100 nm at 0-45 deg AOI

notes.convention: Body +z = outward surface normal. Reflection: d' = d - 2(d.n)n via reflect_specular op.
notes.coating: E03 = Thorlabs broadband dielectric, R_avg > 99% over 750-1100 nm at AOI 0-45 deg (s and p averaged). Substrate is N-BK7 (1-inch, 6 mm thick).
notes.geometry: Standard 1-inch round mirror in a 6 mm thick substrate. STL at files/stl/thorlabs_bb1_e03.stl is the actual Thorlabs CAD.
